run_offline_tool_calling_demo: run an offline vLLM chat demo with tool calling using a Mistral model
create_llm_with_sampling_params: create a vLLM LLM instance with SamplingParams for max tokens and temperature control
chat_with_tools: call llm.chat with messages and a tools list to get function-calling output from the model
generate_random_tool_call_id: generate a random alphanumeric ID string for use as a tool_call_id in tool messages
execute_tool_function_from_llm_output: parse LLM tool call output and execute the corresponding tool function with arguments
